verdict.rationale: Apify supports Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium and Crawlee for browser automation, which enables JS rendering and HTML extraction, and community feedback confirms real-world use for headless browser scraping. However, no direct evidence of a dedicated simple API/endpoint for fetching fully rendered HTML (like a single 'render' call), so it requires building/configuring an Actor rather than out-of-the-box rendering.
